services.desc: Skydiving is the closest we humans have gotten to flight - and it feels amazzzing. If you’ve jumped before then you know exactly what we’re talking about, and if you’re taking the leap for the first time, prepare to have your mind blown. Our team of professional tandem instructors are highly-trained and experienced. Our skydiving San Francisco & Bay Area views will take your breath away. And our year-round blue skies mean we fly for 12 straight months. Before you head to the sky for the biggest rush of your life, you’ll participate in a 20-minute training session and get fitted to a harness that connects you to your instructor and the parachute system. blurb: Skydive California offers tandem skydiving experiences with professional instructors, accelerated free fall (AFF) training for solo skydiving licenses, and facilities for licensed skydivers. The dropzone is located near the Bay Area and San Francisco and operates year-round. They host tens of thousands of tandem jumpers, AFF students, and experienced skydivers annually.
